description: A placeholder whose default opens another placeholder.

divergence.note: The baseline placeholder pattern takes any run of non-} characters as the default, so it matches the prefix "${A:-${B}" of a nested reference, substitutes A and leaves the trailing brace: the value becomes "V}". A malformed reference is therefore silently mangled instead of being left alone. The Dart implementation treats a default that opens another placeholder as not a placeholder at all, so the text is returned verbatim.
